articles.summary: An Arbin program takes minutes to write and months to discover it was wrong. Ionworks can parse your schedule file, simulate it against a cell model, and show you exactly what the cycler will do before you load a single cell.
articles.title: Simulate your test protocol before you run it

articles.summary: AC and DC internal resistance measure different physics. PyBaMM simulations show where they agree, where they diverge, and why it matters for cell screening and pre-test characterization.
articles.title: ACIR vs DCIR: what each resistance measurement actually tells you

articles.summary: The Volta Foundation's Battery Report 2025 identifies structured data and simulation software as critical infrastructure for battery R&D. Here's what matters for modeling teams.
articles.title: What the Battery Report 2025 means for simulation teams

articles.summary: A practical framework for understanding where your battery R&D team sits on the AI spectrum, what infrastructure determines your level, and what it takes to move up.
articles.title: Four levels of AI in battery R&D: from zero to full-context agents

articles.summary: A Python library for reading battery cycling data from Maccor, BioLogic, Neware, Arbin, and other cyclers into a single consistent format. We know there are plenty of these. We're putting it out there in case it's useful.
articles.title: ionworks-data is open source

articles.summary: A solver can run in seconds. Assembling a defensible parameter set often takes weeks. A practical guide to battery parameter estimation across ECM, SPM/SPMe, and DFN models, with the data each one actually needs.
articles.title: Battery Parameter Estimation for R&D Teams

articles.summary: A physics-based model is posed in thickness and porosity. A manufacturer designs in mass loading and press density. Linked parameters recast the model in the inputs each team already thinks in, with the derived quantities updating symbolically.
articles.title: Linked parameters: rebuilding a battery model in manufacturing inputs

articles.summary: A 1D model tells you how a cell performs. A 3D model tells you where in the cell performance breaks down. Full 3D electrochemical simulation is now available in Ionworks, using the same PyBaMM environment and parameter set you already work in.
articles.title: Full 3D battery simulation is now available in Ionworks
